evidence_value_for_essay: Low-cost high-capability models made API use less like rare enterprise experimentation and more like routine software infrastructure.

token_economy_proxy: OpenAI's GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 mini pricing shows clear model price segmentation.
evidence_value_for_essay: Developers can route high-value tasks to frontier models and ordinary tasks to cheaper models.

token_economy_proxy: Research and industry commentary warn that agentic workflows can consume many more tokens than simple chat.
evidence_value_for_essay: Cheap listed tokens do not automatically mean cheap agents; cost governance becomes part of the economic mechanism.

token_economy_proxy: Reuters reports corporate concern about volatile AI bills and token-heavy workflows.
evidence_value_for_essay: This supports the downside scenario: token abundance can create cost shocks if workflows are not governed.
